summary: Iteration 2 — Full end-to-end validation of the new demo-mode flow (POST /api/auth/demo-session + 3 seeded tickets) against the public preview URL. Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass covering demo-session lifecycle, stats (2/1/10), 3 demo tickets exposed with full transcripts + notes + vocal summaries, notes/vocal persistence after PATCH, demo sync that never contacts Discord, archive/reactivate, demo scope isolation, cookie clearing on logout, unauthenticated 401 guards preserved, and no MongoDB _id leakage. Frontend desktop (1920x1080): login-page → demo-access-btn opens session (no Discord redirect), dashboard shows exactly TKT-0891/TKT-0890/TKT-0888 with stats 2/1/10, ticket-row-TKT-0891 opens workspace, vocal-play-button toggles waveform is-playing, notes and vocal input save and persist after full page reload, sync-ticket-button on a demo dossier does not contact Discord and preserves notes/vocal, and after POST /api/auth/logout the /tickets/TKT-0891 route falls back to the login page (route protection). Mobile 390x800 dashboard has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). CRITICAL BUG CONFIRMED: the helper-message transcript bubbles (demo-891-2 and demo-891-4) still render vertically (text container width = 0, height > 1200 px) despite the CSS 'fix' claimed by main agent. This is exactly the regression the review asked to verify — the fix is INSUFFICIENT.

ui_bugs.issue: Helper reply bubbles render with text container width = 0 (each character on its own line, bubble height ~1200-1300px) on desktop. Confirmed on demo-891-2 and demo-891-4 in TKT-0891. Root cause: .transcript-message uses grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); and .transcript-message.helper-message img { order: 2; } — CSS Grid auto-placement follows the `order` value, so the avatar (order 2) is placed in the 1fr column and the message content div (default order 0) is forced into the 28px column, collapsing the text to a single-character width. The CSS override at App.css:479-508 is the source. Fix suggestion: for .transcript-message.helper-message, reverse the columns e.g. grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px; (and keep img order:2), or drop `order` and use direction/row-reverse via display:flex. Member messages (demo-891-1, demo-891-3) are unaffected (width 553px, height 20px).

action_items: Fix helper-message bubble collapse in frontend/src/App.css: change .transcript-message.helper-message to grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px (matching img { order: 2 }), or restructure with flex-row-reverse so the avatar sits on the right without forcing the text into the 28px column. Verify visually that demo-891-2 and demo-891-4 render as single-line paragraphs, not vertical stacks of characters.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_service.demo_helper() cleanly mints an AuthenticatedHelper with mode='demo' and the HMAC-signed cookie flows through the same parse_session path — no separate auth branch, good.

tickets.ticket_scope() correctly partitions demo vs real tickets by demo_ticket flag ($or {exists:false} OR {demo:false} for the real branch), so a demo helper cannot see real tickets and vice-versa — verified with test_no_real_tickets_appear_in_demo_scope and test_create_ticket_denied_for_demo_helper.
sync_ticket() short-circuits when ticket.is_demo is True and only refreshes last_synced_at — never hits DiscordService, exactly as required.
demo_data.seed_demo_tickets uses {$setOnInsert} + upsert, so notes/vocal edits on a demo ticket are not overwritten on server restart. Confirmed with reload-persistence UI test.

TicketWorkspacePage renders the helper vs member class correctly (author.id === 'iris-demo-helper' → helper-message), but the App.css override for helper-message with `order: 2` and a `28px minmax(0, 1fr)` grid is the direct cause of the vertical-text regression. Not a business-logic bug — a pure CSS grid placement mistake.
LoginPage.openDemo does not clear the loading state on success (window.location.assign is fine, but if the reload is delayed the spinner shows longer than needed). Minor UX only.
AuthenticatedApp.updateTicket recomputes stats via a separate /tickets/stats fetch on every ticket update — fine but wasteful; consider incremental client-side stats. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue:
Helper bubble vertical text — Root Cause Analysis. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/auth/demo-session (2) open /tickets/TKT-0891 (3) inspect [data-testid='transcript-message-demo-891-2']. Observed: outer bbox 620x1294, inner

bbox width=0 height=1229. Root cause: in /app/frontend/src/App.css lines 479-508, .transcript-message declares `grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr)` and .transcript-message.helper-message img adds `order: 2`. In CSS Grid, `order` participates in auto-placement — the visually-second item is placed into grid-column 2. Since only two children exist (img and div) and img is now order:2, img is placed in column 2 (the 1fr wide track) and the content div (order 0) is placed in column 1 (the 28px track). Result: the text container is 28px wide, wrapping every character. Mitigation: either reverse grid-template-columns for helper-message to `minmax(0, 1fr) 28px` (keeps `order:2`), or drop `order` on img and instead use `direction: rtl` on the row / flip with a separate DOM order for helpers, or restructure to flex with `flex-direction: row-reverse` and `img { flex: 0 0 28px; }` on the helper variant. The simplest one-line fix is: `.transcript-message.helper-message { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px; }` inside the existing helper-message rule.
